[SWS_CM_10444] Failures during deserialization of response messages
⌈
In
case of failures during deserialization of response messages, the ara::com imple-
mentation shall make the Future returned by the Set or Get method of the re-
spective Field class (see [SWS_CM_00112] and [SWS_CM_00113]) ready accord-
ing to [SWS_CM_10440].
⌋
